Zod schema: AuditLogEntry + AuditEntityType + AuditAction + createStatusChangeEntry() factory. Immutable, append-only by convention.
61 vitest cases covering all 9 Zod schemas — shape validation, FSM transitions, helpers. 581 lines.

pgTable: users (id/email/emailVerifiedAt/name/imageUrl/status/createdAt/updatedAt) + userStatusEnum
pgTable: organizations + organizationStatusEnum
pgTable: workspaces + workspaceStatusEnum; unique(workspace organizationId, slug)
pgTable: role_assignments (composite UNIQUE, not PK, because workspaceId is nullable) + roleNameEnum
pgTable: projects + projectStatusEnum; unique(workspaceId, slug)
pgTable: tasks + taskTypeEnum + taskStatusEnum; index on workspaceId/projectId/createdBy
pgTable: generation_runs (JSONB snapshot) + generationRunStatusEnum; unique(taskId, runNumber)
pgTable: artifacts + artifactKindEnum + artifactStorageKindEnum; index on generationRunId/workspaceId
pgTable: audit_log (JSONB before/after/metadata) + auditEntityTypeEnum + auditActionEnum; append-only by convention
